procurementEvents.notes: Factual procurement chronology. PO issued and requested-arrival dates are distinct from shipment or receipt dates.

procurementEvents.workCompleted: Fox Blocks procurement record: the Project Lead Tracking row records the order placed for Airlite/EPS orders 78145-EPS and 78146-EPS.
Fox Blocks procurement record: Airlite acknowledgements record requested ship dates of 2021-06-16 for order 78145-EPS and 2021-06-17 for order 78146-EPS.
procurementEvents.notes: The acknowledgement labels these as requested ship dates.

procurementEvents.workCompleted: Fox Blocks procurement record: the internal tracker lists an expected delivery window of 2021-08-02 through 2021-08-13.
procurementEvents.notes: Expected-date range only; this entry does not record an actual delivery.

procurementEvents.workCompleted: Fox Blocks procurement record: the tracker states “new order to Toni 8/19/21” and records a revised block mix.
procurementEvents.notes: No imported operational source states a reason for the revision. The acknowledgement and tracker quantities differ.

procurementEvents.workCompleted: Fox Blocks procurement record: Airlite invoices 189194-EPS and 189195-EPS show ship date 2021-09-01. A project daily-log source states that block was unloaded from trailers and brought to the site.
procurementEvents.notes: Calendar intervals across the documented chronology are 76–78 days from the two requested ship dates to the two actual delivery dates, and 19–31 days outside the internal 2021-08-02 through 2021-08-13 expected window.

procurementEvents.workCompleted: Fox Blocks procurement record: the internal tracker records a second actual delivery date of 2021-09-02; a project daily-log source records stacking to the second course.
procurementEvents.notes: Calendar intervals across the documented chronology are 76–78 days from the two requested ship dates to the two actual delivery dates, and 19–31 days outside the internal 2021-08-02 through 2021-08-13 expected window. Exact Buildertrend daily-log IDs/URLs for the 2021-09-01 and 2021-09-02 narratives are not present in the current 249-record Compass register.
